ui.settings.page.title: Settings
ui.settings.page.subtitle_admin: Manage appearance, server, members and permissions
ui.settings.appearance.device_only_hint: Applies only to the browser on this device (stored in localStorage)
ui.settings.appearance.reset_confirm_des: Theme, interface density, font size, sidebar collapse, background noise, reduced motion and file browsing defaults will all return to the factory settings.
ui.settings.appearance.theme_shortcut_hi: Press `D` on any page to cycle through the themes too.
ui.settings.appearance.density_hint: Compact tightens list row heights and card padding, so more items fit on one screen.
ui.settings.appearance.font_scale_hint: Scales all interface text (Tailwind sizes are in rem, so changing the root font size is enough).
ui.settings.appearance.sidebar_collapsed: Desktop only; the drawer on narrow screens is not affected.
ui.settings.appearance.noise_hint: A subtle noise texture behind the page; turning it off gives a cleaner background.
ui.settings.appearance.reduce_motion_hin: Turns off entrance animations for pages and lists, along with interface transitions.
ui.settings.appearance.webmcp_label: Allow in-browser AI to use the drive
ui.settings.appearance.webmcp_hint: When on, an AI agent in this browser (WebMCP) can list folders, create files and mint public share links with your account's permissions. Off by default - enable only if you trust that agent.
ui.settings.appearance.file_browse_defau: The initial view and sorting used when opening the files page (you can still change them there, and the change is recorded here as well)
ui.settings.appearance.folders_first_hin: Always list folders before files when sorting.
ui.settings.members.title: Team members (junior admins)
ui.settings.members.desc: Members can work with files but cannot enter server management. {count} in total
ui.settings.members.created_notice: Created successfully. Save the account details (username password):
ui.settings.members.avatar_reset_confirm: The uploaded avatar file will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
ui.settings.members.empty_hint: No members yet, click "Add member" to create one
ui.settings.members.create_dialog_label: One account per line: "username password"; the password is generated when omitted
ui.settings.members.create_dialog_hint: Username 2-32 characters (letters/digits/_.-), password at least 6 characters
ui.settings.members.delete_confirm_singl: This member will be permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
ui.settings.members.delete_confirm_batch: The {count} selected members will be permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
ui.settings.perms.hidden_paths_empty: None yet. Pick one with "Choose directory" above, or right-click a folder in the file list and hide it
ui.settings.perms.unhide_confirm_desc: The directory will appear in the guest listing again.
ui.settings.perms.cannot_hide_root: The root directory cannot be hidden
ui.settings.security.rate_limit_desc: Limits how many archive, extract, search, detail-view and link-download operations a single IP can run per minute, so the CPU and disk cannot be flooded. Normal directory browsing and single-file downloads are unaffected.
ui.settings.security.extract_protection_: Limits the total size after extracting a ZIP; when it is exceeded, extraction is aborted and the written content is cleaned up, so a small archive cannot fill the disk.
ui.settings.security.soft_dir_allow_copy: Allow copying content from read-only mapped directories
When off, content in externally mapped directories (read-only virtual folders) cannot be copied or compressed into the drive's directories
ui.settings.security.job_status_owner_on: Job progress visible only to its creator
When off, team members can see each other's file names and progress for compress / extract / link-download jobs
ui.settings.security.download_url_allow_: Allow link downloads to reach private addresses
When off, the link downloader is blocked from private / loopback / cloud metadata addresses (SSRF protection)
ui.settings.security.csrf_origin_check: Validate the request origin for write operations
ui.settings.security.csrf_origin_check_h: Rejects write requests coming from other sites (checks Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site). If a reverse proxy rewrites the Host header and causes false rejections, turn it off here
ui.settings.security.client_ip_badge_hin: Used for logging and per-IP rate limiting
ui.settings.security.trust_proxy_desc_b: in the server .env; restart the service after changing it. When the service is reached only through a tunnel / reverse proxy, set it to
ui.settings.security.trust_proxy_desc_c: so logs and rate limiting use the real client IP; if the service can also be reached directly, keep it off (the default), otherwise clients can forge this header to bypass rate limiting.
ui.settings.tunnel.starting: Tunnel started, waiting for the connection…
ui.settings.tunnel.start_failed: The tunnel failed to start, check the log below
ui.settings.tunnel.title: SSH reverse tunnel
ui.settings.tunnel.desc: Expose this service to the internet via ssh -R
ui.settings.tunnel.custom_host_hint: Requires a passwordless SSH key configured on this machine
